privacy_description: Learn how this demonstration uses language and theme preferences and where to find its public channels.
privacy_intro: This page describes the privacy features observable in the source code of this SolidJS Boilerplate demonstration. Its public pages do not provide account registration, checkout or a form for submitting personal data.
privacy_preferences: The interface uses cookies to remember the language and theme preference. The language also appears in the page address, such as /pt, /en or /es. These preferences keep the presentation consistent between visits. You can delete or block cookies through your browser settings; a choice may then stop persisting on your next visit.
privacy_hostingTitle: Accessing the site and external links
privacy_hosting: When you access this site, your browser sends technical information needed for the HTTP connection to the hosting infrastructure. This notice does not establish a retention period for that infrastructure's logs. Links to GitHub and other services lead to websites with their own policies. Information posted in a public issue is available to other people on that service.
